name: ai-debate-partner
description: A small web app for practising timed debates against an AI opponent

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('server/.env')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','server/.env')" && npm install && npm run db:push -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
